gloss: special news bulletin; breaking news; emergency broadcast

definitions.gloss: special news bulletin; breaking news; emergency broadcast
definitions.explanation: Used when regular programming is interrupted for urgent news.

examples.japanese: {臨時|りんじ}ニュース⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We bring you a special news bulletin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{臨時|りんじ}ニュースです。
examples.english: We interrupt this program for a special news bulletin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{直後|ちょくご}→直後：04525_chokugo⟧、⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{臨時|りんじ}ニュース⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れた→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: Right after the earthquake, a special news bulletin aired on TV.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{臨時|りんじ}→臨時：04092_rinji⟧ (extraordinary/special) and ⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧ (news). Used for urgent broadcasts that interrupt regular programming, typically for natural disasters, major incidents, or critical announcements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {臨時|りんじ}ニュース⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧: standard announcer phrase for breaking news
- {臨時|りんじ}ニュース⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: a news bulletin comes in
- {臨時|りんじ}ニュース⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧: a news bulletin airs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{速報|そくほう}→速報：14319_sokuhou⟧: breaking news flash (shorter, more urgent)
- ⟦{特報|とくほう}→特報：17800_tokuhou⟧: special report (emphasis on exclusivity)
- {緊急速報|きんきゅうそくほう}: emergency alert (used for earthquake warnings, etc.)

USAGE:
The phrase {臨時|りんじ}ニュース⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧ is one of the most recognizable formulaic expressions in Japanese broadcasting. Hearing it on TV or radio immediately signals a serious event.
